decisions.reason: The custom earmold for in-ear systems fits squarely in the firm's established hearing-care business and digital earmold production, so the sunk investment and strategic fit favour keeping it despite its modest visibility.

The EARsleeve has its own page and is publicly positioned as completing universal in-ear hearing systems, so the visible commitment and its centrality to the announced direction make keeping it the clear choice.
The vacuum thermoforming unit belongs to a core dental equipment line with substantial sunk development and certification costs, and any weak results can still be attributed to the launch phase.

Although the orthopedic shoe last is distant from the core offer, the firm recently gave it a dedicated page and it extends the announced digital manufacturing direction, so management would persist and attribute early weakness to market entry.
The post-curing unit complements the firm's digital and 3D-printing workflow and its certified equipment range, so its strategic fit and recent investment favour keeping it.
